description: Direct credit packs (product 'direct'): direct100c or direct1000 or direct10000. Tops up something that already exists; to start a new answering line use set_up_answering_line. Returns a one-time Stripe checkout link for a prepaid pack; the customer opens it and pays on Stripe's own page, and this connection never sees the card. Only call it when the customer asked to buy, and tell them the price first. Products: 'formats' (Odile Formats credits; packs from get_catalog), 'minutes' (meeting minutes, only where Meeting Notes is on), 'line_minutes' (phone minutes for a new After Hours line; line_id required: min40: 40 minutes for $10; min200: 200 minutes for $50), 'line_outcomes' (resolved conversations for an outcome line; line_id required: out50: 50 resolved conversations for $24.50; out200: 200 resolved conversations for $98), 'photos' (Plate API photo credits: starter: 1000 photos for $10; growth: 5000 photos for $45; scale: 20000 photos for $160), 'calls' (legacy per-call lines only). What was paid is added within a minute of payment, whatever device paid it. Nothing renews. Needs a signed-in connection with the billing:checkout permission. Returns { checkout_url, product, pack, price_cents, units, unit, then }.
